rationale: No exact solution exists in this template. Even the directional nearest-colour key omits distance: demonstration 1 pixels (4,1) and (4,2), using zero-based coordinates, have identical keys with background 8 but require outputs 7 and 8. The other key kinds also cannot express the required distance-dependent rotation.

Select pixel count. The large objects have counts 31, 14, 24, 16, and 30, mapping respectively to 7, 3, 2, 3, and 2; the small objects have counts 5 or 6 and map to 0. This reproduces all supplied demonstrations and the counterexample; generalisation is limited to learned counts.

No solution exists in this template. Object recolouring cannot move pixels or create the required coloured pixels in the background. Choosing a different background does not help: the zero component has nonuniform target colours and is therefore ignored.
